contents.name: Lemma 29, even rectangle approximation
contents.detail: The formula printed in this source fails its asserted range at the positive shift used in Theorem 41; it is not used. A corrected local window is proved separately.
contents.reason: The printed expression gives P′(0)≥1+e′²/4>1 for t=3/4 and delta′=delta/4, contradicting the claimed |P′|≤1; the local item proves a different corrected formula.

contents.name: Lemma 40, odd reciprocal polynomial approximation
contents.detail: Local binomial reciprocal, erf/Chebyshev interpolation, corrected cutoff, strict product margin and Bernstein refinement proof establishes the full stated degree/error and uncapped termination; arithmetic bit costs remain separate.

contents.name: Theorem 41, bounded gapped Moore–Penrose transform
contents.detail: Local binomial reciprocal, erf/Chebyshev interpolation, corrected cutoff, strict product margin and Bernstein refinement proof establishes the full stated degree/error and uncapped termination; arithmetic bit costs remain separate.

contents.name: Definition 43, block-encoding construction and access

contents.name: Theorem 21, variable-time amplitude amplification
contents.detail: Qualified tight production bound with finite supplied probability/schedule certificates and full C_build, plus a distinct actual uniform-floor/confidence implementation with counted estimation and deterministic cap. contents.detail: Local low-target/estimation/telescoping proof gives the actual finite near-linear condition-number quantum query/gate cap under its declared efficient access/implementation coordinates; classical generation and bit work stay separate.
